question: Where is fast food restaurant found within 60 kilometers along the way to Wolfeboro Chamber of Commerce, NH from Blue Ocean Discovery Center, Hampton, NH?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'fast_food' AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Blue Ocean Discovery Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Hampton%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Wolfeboro Chamber of Commerce%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NH%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 60000 -- 60 kilometers in meters ) );
